ja.title: 「AI と旅する」: 今年の ChinaJoy は AI をテーマにしました
ja.summary: インタビュー：Chen Ke'an、Gao Lingxiao、Zhou Yubo 執筆：Zhou Yubo 7月31日午前、ChinaJoy N4ホールのテンセントゲーム展示エリアでは、まだテスト段階にあるAIゲーム制作プラットフォーム「Codename: Craft」がブースに置かれ、プレイヤーが体験できるようになった。 Chule の編集者は、「サイバーパンク ピクセル スタイルのパズル アドベンチャー ゲームの生成を手伝ってください」というプロンプトを入力しました。画面上に「ゲーム開発アシスタント」が現れ、「核となるゲームプレイ ループは何ですか? 主要なパズル メカニズムは何ですか? 物語の深さは何ですか?」と順番に尋ねてきました。これらの質問に答えた後、Craft は独自に実行を開始しました。多くの人が各コンピュータの周りに集まりました。生成には約 20 分かかります。待っている間、私たちは他のプレイヤーが作成した AI ゲームを見始めました。プラットフォーム上のゲームのほとんどはカジュアル ゲームです。プレイアブル リストには、プレイヤーが AI を通じてゲームを引き続き変更できる「二次創作」オプションもあります。

en.title: “Traveling with AI”: This year’s ChinaJoy included AI as its theme
en.summary: Interviews: Chen Ke'an, Gao Lingxiao, Zhou Yubo Written by: Zhou Yubo On the morning of July 31, in the Tencent game exhibition area of ​​ChinaJoy N4 Hall, an AI game creation platform called "Codename: Craft" that is still in the testing stage was placed on the booth for players to experience. Chule's editor entered a prompt: "Help me generate a cyberpunk pixel-style puzzle adventure game." A "Game Development Assistant" popped up on the screen and asked us in turn: "What is the core gameplay loop? What kind of puzzle mechanism is the main one? What is the depth of the narrative?" After answering these questions, Craft began to run on its own. Many people gathered around each computer. It takes about 20 minutes to generate. While waiting, we started to look at the AI ​​games created by other players. Most of the games on the platform are casual games. In the playable list, there is also a "second creation" option, where players can continue to modify the game through AI.

en.title: There is no CP that cannot be knocked down, Nuclear City Qitan Vol.122
en.summary: Timeline production of this issue: Old Ax’s CP consumption has long since become a niche hobby and has become a new type of entertainment known to all. Some people stay up late writing fan fiction, and some spend a lot of money to buy peripherals. But calm down and think about it: What are we doing? Are they a real couple? Is it some kind of ideal relationship that we have made up in our minds? Is it an emotional meal replacement? Or is it a large-scale collective brainstorming game? Why can't I help but feel true feelings even though I know it might be fake?

It follows a surge of opposition on social media, including formal petitions and calls for a boycott. Tao Lin responded that Sony understands players’ emotions. However, the overall shift towards digitalization will not change. Tao Lin pointed out that all types of content are accelerating digitization, and the general trend of the entire gaming industry is the main factor in Sony's decision. The company has made a long-term and prudent evaluation and will steadily advance this transformation. Since the game holds fond memories for so many people, she understands these sentiments from the community. ja.summary: 変なものが大好きで、くだらない話や幽霊の話、ゲーム関連の新ネタなどを日々語っています。ロナウジーニョは空冷よりも水冷の方が優れていると鋭く指摘しました (写真 / Ronaldinho) 結論から始めましょう: ドックモードの Switch 2 用ラジエーターを購入したい場合は、A&C のこの排気タイプのラジエーターを選択することをお勧めします。原理的には、Switch 2 コンソールの冷却ファンの効率を向上させ、機体内部から熱をより速く奪うことができ、それによって CPU 付近の温度を下げることができます。エアコンのミニ室外機のようなものです。まだ時間と興味があれば、この奇妙な物語を読んで、しばらく私の話を聞いてください。少し前、「Sprague-Draw: Splatoon」のリリースが近づき、任天堂が今年の下半期にSwitch 2の価格が上がると発表したため、パートナーと私は再びSwitch 2を購入することを思いつきました。 AIの波がもたらす貯蔵サイクルがまだしばらく続くことを考慮すると、来年は買い遅れ割引は行われないはずだ。

en.title: Strange story: It may be the only useful cooler on Switch 2
en.summary: He is very fond of weird things, and talks about nonsense, ghost things, and new things related to games every day. In principle, it can improve the efficiency of the Switch 2 console's cooling fan and draw heat away from the interior of the fuselage faster, thereby lowering the temperature near the CPU. It’s this thing that looks like a mini air conditioner outdoor unit. If you still have time and interest, you can also read this weird story and listen to me chatting for a while. Not long ago, with the release of "Sprague-Draw: Splatoon" coming soon, and Nintendo saying that the price of Switch 2 would increase in the second half of the year, my partner and I had the idea of ​​buying Switch 2 again. Considering that the storage cycle brought about by the AI ​​wave will still last for a while, there should be no late-buying discounts in the next year.
